studentTurns: Hi, thanks for your time. I'm Sam from Stackwell, we offer a project tracking tool for small agencies.
I understand the concern, but our price is actually pretty competitive when you look at everything you get. Most tools charge extra for the things we include.
I think if you tried it you would see the value. Lots of agencies felt the same at first and then they came around.
Is there anything else stopping you? I would really like to find a way to work together.
